notes: certificate DER modelled as public key + signature + 353 B
the constant is measured at run time from real ML-DSA certificates and is identical at all three parameter sets
Falcon and SLH-DSA have no COSE algorithm identifier assigned; the structure uses a placeholder and the size is unaffected
classical rows use real certificates and carry no timing
chain depth 1 is a self-signed signer, included as a lower bound rather than as a deployable configuration
